profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Woodward
profile.summary: Engineering leader passionate about firmware and hardware development for sensing and control of real time systems.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: I lead a small team writing firmware for industrial actuators for big bad engines.
positions.insights: Skills: Electronic Engineering · Embedded Software · Modeling and Simulation · Power Electronics · Motor Control

positions.title: Engineering Manager at Advanced Energy
positions.locationName: Fort Collins, Colorado, United States · On-site
positions.description:
I led a 16 member multidisciplinary team developing state of the art DC and pulsed power supplies for the semiconductor industry
- Rapidly produced and iterated on prototypes for next generation, pulsed high voltage power supplies
- Oversaw firmware development for next generation products
- Created an architecture to automate firmware testing
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Systems Modeling · Programming · Power Electronics · Electronic Hardware · Debugging · C++ · Real-time Control Systems · MATLAB · Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Debugging Code · I2C

positions.title: North American Research and Development Manager
positions.description:
I led the engineering teams for Nova Instrument’s North American holdings: Degree Controls, Brookhaven Instruments and NDT Systems.
- Continued to develop new airflow sensors for Degree Controls
- Resolved technical deadlocks on Brookhaven Instrument’s next generation Particle Analyzers
- Led modernization of legacy products for NDT like the TG-110, Curlin Air and Novascope.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · C (Programming Language) · Freescale · Programming · Electronic Hardware · Debugging · C++ · Battery Management Systems · Microchip · Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Debugging Code · I2C

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Led a multidisciplinary team of 15 engineers and technicians in India and New Hampshire to develop and manufacture state of the art embedded systems to sense and control air flow.
- Responsible for development, release and manufacturing infrastructure of: Handheld Airflow Instruments and associate mobile apps,  PCB Mount airflow sensors, airflow switches, bidirectional airflow sensors, combined humidity sensors, differential pressure monitors, datalogging software
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · C (Programming Language) · Programming · Electronic Hardware · Debugging · C++ · Battery Management Systems · Real-time Control Systems · Microchip · Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Debugging Code · I2C · Assembly Language

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Technical lead for a 4 person team developing novel control algorithms for networks of controllers to coordinate complex HVAC systems
- Developed algorithms for optimal compressor and pump efficiency in HVAC industry
- Wrote firmware for FOC of Brushless DC motors
- Mentored Junior Software engineers, wrote specifications, code standards and schedules
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · C (Programming Language) · Systems Modeling · Programming · Electronic Hardware · Debugging · C++ · Real-time Control Systems · MATLAB · Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Debugging Code · I2C · Assembly Language

positions.title: Lead Embedded Controls Engineer
positions.description:
- Responsible for the controls for the power production system of a 8MW Wind Turbine Generator.
- Wrote Specifications, control simulations and test procedures for back to back 8MW Medium Voltage Grid-Tie Inverter and Motor Drive/Generator
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Systems Modeling · Programming · Power Electronics · Debugging · C++ · Renewable Energy Systems · Real-time Control Systems · MATLAB · Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Debugging Code · I2C

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible as lead FW engineer for modeling and implementing the following power electronics products using Simulink, TI 24xx and 28xx DSPs:
3.4 MW Grid Tie Inverter and AC Motor controller
30 kW PMSM motor Controller
100 kW Stand Alone / Grid Tie Inverter
C# Based Test Stand and Application for DSP board Verification
